description: Encode and decode UTF-8 text as Base32 (RFC 4648 + hex), Crockford Base32, Base58 (Bitcoin), Ascii85 or Z85. Operations: "encode" — Encode UTF-8 text in the chosen scheme.; "decode" — Decode to UTF-8 text (binary payloads are returned as hex).. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: encode: The text to encode. decode: The encoded string. Whitespace is ignored.

operation.description: encode — Encode UTF-8 text in the chosen scheme. decode — Decode to UTF-8 text (binary payloads are returned as hex).

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

delimiters.description: Ascii85: wrap in <~ ~>. Used by: encode.

padding.description: Base32/Base32hex: emit = padding. Used by: encode.

scheme.description: Encoding scheme. Used by: encode, decode.

name: base-n
title: Base32, Base58 & Base85 Encoder
